role: The software renderer that reproduces llvmpipe's 1.7.10 frame: the sky, sunrise, sun/moon, End sky and clouds, the opaque and translucent chunk passes from the render_blocks mesher, then entities, mobs, the block overlay, particles, weather, the first-person hand and screen overlays and the HUD, either from a recorded RenderStateProbe/MeshProbe scene (raster_render) or live for the playable client with cached section meshes and a thread pool (raster_live_*).

structs.name: frame
structs.java: the GL state of one EntityRenderer.renderWorld frame as RenderStateProbe records it: projection, modelview, fog, sky and cloud colours, celestial angle, moon phase, lightmap

structs.name: water_quad
structs.java: the per-quad back-to-front sort of a translucent section

structs.name: live_section
structs.java: a WorldRenderer's cached display list for one 16x16x16 section and pass

gpu: lines 860, 1108, 1882-1883, 1906, functions draw_section, draw_mesh, raster_live_frame: malloc of sort buffers every frame
lines 1655-1662, function live_list_push and line 1875, function raster_live_frame: realloc-grown triangle lists per frame

lines 821-826, function water_section_compare: returns 0 on equal distances, so qsort (line 1121) leaves tied translucent sections in an unspecified order (the live path's live_water_compare breaks ties by index)
lines 1287-1328, 1483-1488, 1691-1693, 1771-1810: a pthread pool with a shared mutex, atomic stage counter and shared work counter; bands are rasterized in parallel
line 1535, function live_now_ms: clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC) wall-clock read, used only for raster_live_stats timing
lines 854, 1094, 1099 and the alloc/json helpers at lines 61-163: exit(1) on a full mesher buffer, a load failure or malformed scene JSON
notes: Render layer, outside the tick; the product frame path per SPEC is frames at partial tick 1.0 on request, so the hazards above matter for a GPU renderer port, not for tick state. The file dispatches to raster_sky2.c (sun and moon), raster_entities.c, raster_mobs.c, raster_overlay.c, raster_particles.c, raster_worldfx.c, raster_hand.c and raster_hud.c; those Java ports are recorded in their own files. Java member names here come from the file's comments plus a grep of the Java sources; per-member exactness against pixel gates is asserted by test_render.c (pixel equality with the oracle's frames), not re-verified here. The play client (csrc/play/play.c) drives raster_live_*. lane/skytex: sky_mode 8 is the star pass (blend SRC_ALPHA, ONE as llvmpipe's rounded 8-bit product, colour getStarBrightness * (1 - rain)); the live list's mode byte holds sky_mode in its low 4 bits; the recorded atlases are patched to the frame's animation (texanim_patch_scene) and raster_live_animate uploads the live client's. lane/particles2: draw_mesh draws the translucent terrain (sortAndRender pass 1, no depth writes) after the entities, the overlay and the particles, as EntityRenderer.renderWorld does, so particles behind water or a portal are blended over. lane/entrender: raster_things_scene after the mobs. draw_mesh runs the tile-entity pass (raster_tileent.c raster_tileents_scene) after the mobs, as RenderGlobal.renderEntities' block-entity loop follows the entities. lane/clientstate: a row's "inside" list (ClientStateProbe) names the blocks drawn a second time from inside, per section, since that geometry stays in the section until its next rebuild whatever the camera does; rows without it keep the mesh dump's camera block. raster_live_obs hands the last live frame to the device renderer as data (raster_obs.h) and raster_obs_render is the C renderer over such a dump; csrc/cuda/render/host.cu ports this file's passes operation for operation (mirrors.txt lists them). A stale section pass keeps its mesh and version while its key (raster_meshkey.c: what the mesher reads) holds, and a pass no cell of the section is drawn in takes the empty mesh without the mesher (lane/remesh); host meshing walks only the band's cells drawn in the pass; raster_live_mesh_check meshes the spared passes again the reference way (rb_mesh_section) and compares. lane/renderprec: the frame's precision (raster_prec.h; frame.prec from raster_live_set_prec or raster_obs.prec): light_sample_h and shade_h are the float16 stages, RP_XFORM's camera offset is in make_vertex, RP_RCP in triangle().
